column1: # Motion Prompt catalog (en) · 313 elements · https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/ · columns: id
column4: title
column6: summary

column4: Modal dialog (モーダル)
column6: Clicking "Open" dims the whole page and a small window scales up slightly into the centre; clicking × closes it.

column4: Drawer (Off-canvas) (ドロワー)
column6: Clicking "Menu" slides a tall panel in from the left; clicking outside slides it back.

column4: Bottom sheet (ボトムシート)
column6: A finger taps "View details" and a panel rises from the bottom; dragging its handle down closes it.

column4: Accordion (アコーディオン)
column6: Clicking the first of three headings opens its content and pushes the rows below down; clicking again closes it.

column4: Dropdown (select) (ドロップダウン)
column6: Clicking the field opens four options below it; picking "Nagoya" closes the list and fills the field.

column4: Tooltip (ツールチップ)
column6: Hovering over a "?" icon shows a short note in a dark bubble above it; it disappears when the cursor leaves.

column4: Popover (ポップオーバー)
column6: Clicking "Details" opens a small white panel to its right with a pointer at the button; clicking OK inside closes it.

column4: Toast notification (トースト)
column6: Clicking "Save" slides a dark notice into the bottom-right corner; when its time bar runs out it slides away.

column4: Tabs (タブ)
column6: Clicking the tabs "Overview, Pricing, Reviews" in turn slides a blue underline across and swaps the content below.

column4: Carousel (カルーセル)
column6: Each click on the right arrow slides a row of three different images one step to the left, and the dot below moves.

column4: Toggle switch (トグルスイッチ)
column6: The switches on the first two of three setting rows are turned on in turn, then off again.

column4: Segmented control (セグメントコントロール)
column6: Clicking Day, Week or Month slides a blue highlight across and the bar chart below changes height.

column4: Filter chips (チップ)
column6: Clicking the "New" and "Free" chips adds a check mark and turns them blue, and cards that do not match fade out.

column4: Range slider (レンジスライダー)
column6: On a price slider, the left handle is dragged right and the right handle left to narrow the range, then both go back.

column4: Stepper (+/−) (ステッパー)
column6: Pressing + three times raises the number from 1 to 4, and pressing − three times brings it back to 1; the number pops on each press.

column4: Pagination (ページネーション)
column6: Clicking 2 and then 3 in the page numbers moves the blue circle and swaps the list above; finally it goes back to 1.

column4: Hamburger menu (ハンバーガーメニュー)
column6: Clicking the three-line icon at the header's right turns it into ×, and a menu drops down from under the header; clicking again closes it.

column4: Breadcrumbs (パンくずリスト)
column6: Clicking "Courses" in the breadcrumbs goes up to the list page; clicking a card there returns to the detail page.

column4: Mega menu (メガメニュー)
column6: Hovering over "Products" in the header drops a full-width panel with three columns of links and an image; it closes when the cursor leaves.

column4: Step indicator (ステップインジケーター)
column6: Each click on "Next" turns the next of four step circles into a check and extends the blue line to the following step.

column4: Skeleton screen (スケルトン)
column6: Clicking reload turns the list into grey blocks of the same shape with a sweeping shine; the content returns when loading ends.

column4: Spinner (スピナー)
column6: Clicking "Send" washes the card white and a blue arc spins in the middle; when finished it changes to a check and fades.

column4: Badge (バッジ)
column6: Each time a notification arrives, the blue dot on the bell in the header counts up 1, 2, 3; clicking the bell clears it.

column4: Empty state (エンプティステート)
column6: Deleting the two list rows with their trash icons brings up an empty-box drawing, "Nothing here yet" and an "Add" button.

column4: Scale in (スケールイン)
column6: Clicking "Open" grows the dialog from 0.95× to full size as it fades in, stopping without overshoot; closing plays the same path in reverse.

column4: Origin-aware animation (起点を意識したアニメーション)
column6: The same menu side by side: on the left it swells from its own centre in mid-air; on the right it grows out of the "More" button and shrinks back into it.

column4: Rubber-banding (ラバーバンド)
column6: Pulling a fully open bottom sheet further up gets heavier and heavier, the sheet lags behind the finger, and on release it snaps back to the edge.

column4: Interruptible animation (中断できるアニメーション)
column6: Tapping again while the drawer is half open does not wait for it to finish; it carries on a little, then turns smoothly and closes.

column4: Drag to reorder (ドラッグで並べ替え)
column6: The first row is grabbed and lifted, dragged down two rows; each row it passes slides up out of the way, and on release it settles into its new place.

column4: OTP input fill (ワンタイムコード入力)
column6: Digits drop into six boxes in turn, the active box glowing blue; when all are filled every box turns blue, the hint switches to "Verified" and the group lifts slightly.

column4: Password strength meter (パスワード強度メーター)
column6: As the dots in the "New password" field grow from 4 to 16, the four bars below light up one at a time and the strength label shifts from red to green.

column4: Drag-and-drop upload (ドラッグ＆ドロップでアップロード)
column6: A file card drops into the dashed upload zone from above; the border turns solid, the progress bar fills, and at 100% it reads "Ready to publish".

column4: Keyboard shortcut press (ショートカットキーの点灯)
column6: On a dark keyboard plate Ctrl, Shift and P press down and glow amber in turn; the caption builds up, the plate gives a small pulse and the text changes to "Queued".

column4: Code diff highlight (コード差分のハイライト)
column6: In a dark five-line editor the context lines brighten, then a red removed line and a green added line slide in from the left, and the added line's background deepens once before settling.

column4: Deploy pipeline (デプロイパイプライン)
column6: Four stage cards on a dark background run left to right; each one that passes glows green at its border and dot, a line extends to the next, and the final Deploy card reads "Live".

column4: Pricing toggle (料金プラン切り替え)
column6: The cursor clicks Yearly: the knob slides over, the three prices roll down card by card and the recommended middle card grows with a blue outline; later it switches back to Monthly.

column4: Liquid radio (リキッドラジオボタン)
column6: The cursor picks 4 stacked options in turn; the selection dot flows to each new ring stretched like a droplet and rounds off, and the card on the right updates.

column4: Floating label (フローティングラベル)
column6: The cursor clicks the field: the label shrinks, moves up and turns blue, the underline spreads from the centre and an email address is typed letter by letter; it is then cleared and blurred.

column4: Expanding search (展開する検索ボックス)
column6: The cursor clicks a round magnifier button; it widens to the left into a search field with its right edge fixed, a placeholder appears, a query is typed, and clearing it with × folds it back.

column4: Command palette (コマンドパレット)
column6: The ⌘K keys press, the page dims and a panel appears; typing "Settings" narrows the list with matches in blue, the highlight moves down a row and is confirmed.

column4: Page flip (ページめくり)
column6: The cursor clicks the right page of an open book twice; each time a leaf narrows over the spine, flips and lands on the left; a final click on the left page turns both leaves back.

column4: Folding card (二つ折りカード)
column6: The cursor clicks the navy cover; it swings open on its left edge to show the inner left half while 3 lines on the right fade up in turn, and it closes again at the end.

column4: Pull to refresh (プルトゥリフレッシュ)
column6: In a phone screen a finger drags the list down; it follows with resistance as the arrow at the top turns, then on release the icon spins, the list springs back and a new message slides in at the top.

column4: Parallax scrolling (パララックススクロール)
column6: As the page scrolls down, the headline moves up normally while the sky and sun, far hills and near hills move more slowly.

column4: Fade-in on scroll (スクロールでフェードイン)
column6: As the page scrolls, the heading, the cards and the body text each rise into place and fade in when they enter the view.

column4: Sticky header (追従ヘッダー)
column6: The announcement strip scrolls away, but the header below it stops at the top edge and the content scrolls underneath.

column4: Pinning (ピン留め)
column6: A navy section stops when it fills the view; further scrolling steps the number and photo through 1→2→3, then the section scrolls on.

column4: Horizontal scroll (横スクロール)
column6: As the page scrolls down, the section holds still and four numbered work cards travel to the left.

column4: Scroll snap (スクロールスナップ)
column6: After a small scroll, the page carries itself the rest of the way until the next section's top lines up with the top of the view.

column4: Scroll progress bar (スクロールプログレスバー)
column6: As the article is read a bit at a time, the line along the top grows from the left and reaches the far end at the bottom of the page.

column4: Highlighter animation (マーカーアニメーション)
column6: As the copy scrolls into view, a yellow highlighter stroke is drawn left to right across the lower half of the key words.

column4: Hover lift (ホバーで浮き上がる)
column6: Only the card under the cursor lifts slightly and its shadow spreads; it settles back when the cursor leaves.

column4: Image zoom on hover (ホバーで画像ズーム)
column6: The photo under the cursor slowly enlarges while its frame stays the same size, and shrinks back when the cursor leaves.

column4: Cursor follower (マウスストーカー)
column6: As the cursor moves around the page, an orange circle follows it a little behind.

column4: Magnetic button (マグネティックボタン)
column6: As the cursor comes near, the button is drawn toward it and follows; when the cursor leaves, the button wobbles back to its place.

column4: Ripple effect (リップルエフェクト)
column6: Each click sends a white circle out from the click point to fill the button, then it fades away.

column4: Underline animation (下線アニメーション)
column6: Under the link the cursor is on, an orange line grows from the left; when the cursor leaves, the line shrinks away to the right.

column4: Before/after slider (ビフォーアフタースライダー)
column6: Dragging the line in the middle of the photo left and right changes how much of the grey "before" (left) and the coloured "after" (right) is shown.

column4: Exit-intent popup (離脱防止ポップアップ)
column6: When the cursor heads out through the top of the page (toward the tabs and close button), the page dims and a "Wait!" popup opens. The × closes it.

column4: Preloader (ローディング画面)
column6: On a navy screen the number under the logo counts from 0% to 100%; then the screen lifts away and the page underneath fades in.

column4: Lazy loading (遅延読み込み)
column6: As grey placeholders scroll into view, a spinner turns in each, and the images fade in as they arrive. The top row is loaded from the start.

column4: Infinite scroll (無限スクロール)
column6: Scrolling down to the end of the list brings up a spinner, then three new items are added so reading can go on.

column4: Page transition (ページ遷移アニメーション)
column6: Clicking a card in the work list sweeps an orange panel across from the left; the URL changes and the panel exits to the right on the detail page. "Back to list" returns the same way.

column4: Smooth scroll (スムーススクロール)
column6: Clicking "Pricing" in the menu glides the page down to the pricing section; the up arrow at the bottom right glides it back to the top.

column4: Marquee (マーキー)
column6: Inside a navy band, large service names separated by orange dots keep moving to the left without a gap.

column4: Animated gradient (グラデーションアニメーション)
column6: Behind the headline, soft patches of orange, light orange, blue and light blue drift in circles and keep blending differently.

column4: Floating animation (ふわふわアニメーション)
column6: Next to the headline, a phone, a heart badge and a rating chip each bob gently out of step, and the shadow under the phone grows and shrinks.

column4: Press / tap feedback (押したときの縮み)
column6: Two identical buttons: the left one does nothing when pressed; the right one shrinks a little with a tighter shadow and recovers on release.

column4: Hold to confirm (長押しで確定)
column6: The first hold is released early and the fill drains back; the second lasts the full 1.2 s, the file card disappears and the button reads "Deleted".

column4: Shared element transition (共有要素トランジション)
column6: A list thumbnail moves and expands straight into the detail page's large image while everything else cross-fades; going back shrinks it along the same path.

column4: Direction-aware transition (方向に合わせたトランジション)
column6: Moving forward through the onboarding slides content to the left; going back slides it to the right, with the page dots following.

column4: Layout animation (レイアウトアニメーション)
column6: Deleting the second card makes the following cards glide into the gap, with the wrapping card moving up diagonally; undo sends each back to its place.

column4: Rotating gradient border (回転グラデーションボーダー)
column6: A multicolour gradient circles the border of a button on a dark page; when the cursor hovers, it spins faster and a glow appears around it.

column4: Jelly button (ゼリーボタン)
column6: The cursor presses the button twice; each time it squashes wide, stretches tall and wobbles back, while the caption counts the items added.

column4: Card deal (カードディール)
column6: Pressing Deal sends 5 cards up from the bottom in turn into a fan; later, Collect sends them back down starting with the last card.

column4: Photo stack shuffle (フォトスタックシャッフル)
column6: Each time the cursor clicks a pile of 4 tilted polaroids, the top one slides out to the right and goes to the bottom while the rest move up a place.

column4: Slice transition (スライストランジション)
column6: The picture in the frame splits into 6 vertical strips that slide away left to right, up, down, up…, revealing the next picture; the same move later brings the first back.

column4: Animated weather icons (アニメーション天気アイコン)
column6: On 4 small cards the sun's rays rotate, a cloud drifts side to side, raindrops fall in turn and a storm cloud's bolt flashes now and then.

column4: Border beam (ボーダービーム)
column6: A rainbow beam, bright at the head and fading at the tail, keeps travelling clockwise around a dark input field.

column4: Line beam (ラインビーム)
column6: Only the bottom edge of a rounded search field lights up, and the light glides from left to right and back.

column4: Inner pulse (インナーパルス)
column6: Inside a pill button, pink, orange and blue glows swell and shrink, and the outline brightens with them.

column4: Outer pulse (アウターパルス)
column6: Layered rainbow rings spread out around a dark input and shrink back, while the field itself stays crisp.

column4: Thinking orb: working (思考オーブ・作業中)
column6: Around a slowly spinning dotted orb, particles with short trails orbit on three tilted paths at different speeds.

column4: Thinking orb: searching (思考オーブ・検索中)
column6: A dotted globe turns while a vertical line of light sweeps over it, brightening the dots it passes.

column4: Thinking orb: listening (思考オーブ・聞き取り中)
column6: Rings of dots swell and shrink one after another from top to bottom, like a wave rolling over the orb.

column4: Thinking orb: connecting (思考オーブ・接続中)
column6: On a turning orb, nodes are joined one link at a time like a constellation, then light packets run along the links before it all fades and restarts.

column4: Thinking orb: composing (思考オーブ・執筆中)
column6: Three bands of dots wrap the orb at different tilts, rippling as they flow, with light running along them.

column4: Gooey morph menu (リキッド展開メニュー)
column6: A cursor clicks the +; three circles stretch out of the white liquid, their necks thin and break, and icons appear. A second click draws them back into one.

column4: Gooey trail (リキッドの尾)
column6: A white indicator moves between three options; the faster it goes, the more it stretches and the bigger the droplet clinging behind it.

column4: Gooey bend (リキッドのしなり)
column6: A white card is dragged side to side; the faster it moves, the more its sides bow backwards, straightening as it slows.

column4: Sunburst rays (サンバースト)
column6: On a dark background, golden rays fan out from behind a centred headline and turn slowly, fading into the background towards the edges.

column4: Rolling word cube (単語キューブの回転)
column6: The cube rolls down one face at a time to reveal the next word, the caption below flips with it, and a progress bar fills between rolls.

column4: Circular text badge (円形テキストバッジ)
column6: Text on a ring spins slowly, accelerates when the pointer arrives, and jumps faster on each click as new words fade in letter by letter.

column4: Scatter & reassemble letters (文字の飛散と再集合)
column6: Coloured capital letters fly apart spinning, fall and bounce under gravity, hover briefly, then snap back into the word one by one.

column4: Word-by-word kinetic captions (単語ごとのキネティック字幕)
column6: When playback starts, words bounce up one at a time, key words swell and tilt before landing in yellow, and finished lines fold up and vanish.

column4: Hand-drawn annotations (手描きの注釈)
column6: Each time a style is picked, the old marks rewind away and new red strokes are drawn word by word, each followed by a lighter second pass.

column4: Spoiler sand cover (ネタバレの砂カバー)
column6: Fine grains flicker over part of a chat bubble; a tap scatters them from that point to reveal the words, and 'hide' gathers them back.

column4: Sentence reading focus (読んでいる文のフォーカス)
column6: As the pointer moves between sentences, only that one sharpens while the rest blur and fade, and a purple bar on the left follows and resizes.

column4: Rippling letters (文字のばね波紋)
column6: As the pointer glides left to right, the big letters beneath lift and tint purple, then bounce down; a button sends a wave across them.

column4: Shrinking sticky card stack (カードの積み重ね固定)
column6: Gradient cards scroll up and pin near the top; each time the next card slides over, the ones beneath shrink and darken into steps.

column4: Scroll-filled sentence (スクロールで塗られる文)
column6: As you scroll, the pale sentence darkens word by word from the start, key words light up purple, and a button springs up at the end.

column4: Per-section background shift (セクションごとの背景切り替え)
column6: Scrolling melts the background into the next flavour colour, the central can tilts as it swaps colour and label, and the copy slides up.

column4: Velocity-lean list (速度で傾くリスト)
column6: A fast flick skews and slightly stretches the column of cards, which springs straight again on stopping; slow scrolling barely tilts it.

column4: Rolling chapter numbers (回転する章番号)
column6: As the body scrolls, the big chapter number on the left rolls to the next like a digit strip, the chapter name slides in, and a ring fills.

column4: Drum time picker (ドラム式時刻ピッカー)
column6: Dragging a wheel rolls the numbers to rest on the centre line, far values tip away and fade, and the alarm time and countdown update.

column4: Grid-beam background (グリッドビーム背景)
column6: Coloured beams with fading tails streak across a faint dark grid, and the grid lights up indigo only around the pointer.

column4: Tilt-to-flat product screen (傾きから正面へのスクリーン)
column6: Scrolling lifts the backward-tilted product window upright as it grows and its shadow deepens; once flat, the chart bars rise in sequence.

column4: Warp starfield (ワープする星空)
column6: Stars drift out from the centre; holding the button accelerates them into blue streaks with a glowing core, and releasing eases back to cruise.

column4: Constellation mesh (星座のようなメッシュ)
column6: Dots drift on a dark field joined by faint lines; the pointer pulls nearby dots in with yellow links, and a click sprays out new dots.

column4: Dot grid ripple (ドットグリッドの波紋)
column6: As the pointer crosses the calm grey grid, rings spread from its trail; dots on the wave swell, lift and shift from blue-violet to teal.

column4: Particles that form words (粒子が文字になる)
column6: On a dark violet background, glowing dots form HELLO, part around the passing pointer, and burst apart on each click to re-form as NICE, then LUCIAN.

column4: Cursor-lit borders (カーソルで光る枠線)
column6: The pointer sweeps in a wave across four dark cards; borders near it glow from violet to blue, then dim slowly once it passes.

column4: Hover-follow preview (ホバーで追う画像プレビュー)
column6: The pointer moves down a dark list of project names; the hovered row shifts right and brightens while a trailing image tilts and slides to the next project.

column4: Cursor photo trail (カーソルの写真の軌跡)
column6: As the pointer crosses a large heading, white-framed photos pop in at random angles and sink away; a click fans out 5 photos at once.

column4: Direction-aware overlay (入った方向からのオーバーレイ)
column6: The pointer crosses a 3 × 3 thumbnail grid from many directions; a dark caption panel slides in from the entry edge and out the exit edge.

column4: Cursor lens reveal (カーソルのレンズで現れる文)
column6: A round lens chases the pointer springily over a two-line headline, revealing another sentence on dark ground; a click expands it to full size, another shrinks it back.

column4: Swipeable card stack (スワイプするカードの山)
column6: The pointer drags the top card right with a tilt, flings it away with a Save stamp, swipes the next one left to Skip, and finally both fly back.

column4: Payment ring & check (支払いリングとチェック)
column6: The pay button shrinks into a circle on click, a ring fills while 3 steps light up, it turns green with a check, and a receipt bounces up from below.

column4: Install progress on icon (アイコン上のインストール進捗)
column6: A dark wedge over a gradient app icon sweeps away clockwise, pauses and resumes on taps, and on completion the icon bounces and an Open button pops in.

column4: Indeterminate to determinate (不確定から確定への進捗)
column6: On a deploy card, streaks sliding through the bar give way to the same bar filling step by step, log lines float in and tick off, and the status pill turns green.

column4: Heart burst like (ハートがはじける「いいね」)
column6: On click the heart squashes then pops, filling red as a ring and coloured dots burst out; the count rolls from 842 to 843 and back on a second click.

column4: Rolling digits (桁ごとに回る数字)
column6: Each update of a large live-visitor number rolls only the changed digits with a slight overshoot, while the trend line beside it shifts one step left.

column4: Isometric data blocks (アイソメトリックのデータブロック)
column6: Isometric blocks rise from the front with a bounce; hovering greys out all but the bar's row and column and shows its value, and switching metrics re-stacks heights in a wave.

column4: Regrouping bubbles (グループが組み替わるバブル)
column6: A cluster of coloured bubbles jostles apart into 4, then 3 groups as tabs switch, then merges back; labels above each group show budget totals.

column4: Live table insert (新しい行が入るテーブル)
column6: New orders slide into the table with a flash; clicking the amount header makes rows pass each other into a new order, and the time header restores it.

column4: Bar chart race (順位が入れ替わる棒グラフ)
column6: Drink bars grow year by year, overtaking bars slide up to swap ranks and a large year ticks on; dragging the slider back plays the ranking in reverse.

column4: Waffle chart flip (反転するワッフルチャート)
column6: Each age-tab click flips only the cells that change colour in a diagonal wave while the percentages roll; hovering a legend item isolates that mode.

column4: Quarterly bubble motion (四半期ごとに動くバブル)
column6: Behind a large quarter label, app bubbles glide across the chart while changing size, one leaving a dotted trail; dragging fast-forwards or rewinds time.

column4: Line chart draw (折れ線グラフの描画)
column6: Over faint gridlines the line grows from left to right, points pop in turn, a gradient area fades in below and a growth label floats up at the end.

column4: Donut chart segments (ドーナツグラフの分割描画)
column6: From the top, the first arc draws clockwise and each next arc continues from where the last ended until the ring closes; the total appears in the centre and the legend slides in on the right.

column4: Holographic card (ホログラムカード)
column6: As the cursor moves over a card on a dark background, the card tilts in 3D, rainbow foil streams across its face and a soft glare follows; it straightens when the cursor leaves.

column4: Tilt parallax image (3Dチルト視差画像)
column6: As the cursor moves over a sunset mountain image, it tilts and enlarges slightly, the sky, sun and ridges shift by different amounts, and a caption slides up from the bottom.

column4: Following eyes (目で追うキャラクター)
column6: Inside the big white eyes of a purple mascot, the black pupils follow the cursor, moving closer to the rim the farther away it is; now and then both eyes blink together.

column4: Scratch reveal (スクラッチ)
column6: Over a coupon covered by a silver coating, the cursor holds and zigzags side to side; its path rubs the coating away to show the free-shipping coupon, and the rest then fades.

column4: Flow field (フローフィールド)
column6: Thin purple and blue lines stream across a dark background like wind or water and fade away; where the cursor passes, the flow curls into a swirl.

column4: Add to cart fly (カートに飛び込む)
column6: When the product card button is pressed, the cup image arcs to the cart in the top right while shrinking; the cart bounces and the badge changes from 2 to 3.

column4: Send plane button (紙飛行機の送信ボタン)
column6: The purple button dips and recovers, its label slides off to the right, and the paper plane winds back before shooting off to the top right; the button turns green with a sent label sliding in, then everything returns and the plane flies back.

column4: Star rating (星評価)
column6: Hovering the 2nd star tints 2 stars and shows a label; clicking the 4th then fills stars 1 to 4 in gold from left to right with a bounce and a "very good" label floats up.

column4: Slide to confirm (スライドして確定)
column6: The capsule knob is first dragged partway and released, bouncing back; the second drag reaches the end, the whole track fills green and the label changes to confirmed. A shine sweeps the hint text.

column4: Circle reveal transition (円形リビール)
column6: As scrolling progresses, a dark chapter 2 grows as a circle from the centre of the light chapter 1 until it covers the card; the first title shrinks away while the second settles from larger to normal size, and scrolling back shrinks the circle.

column4: Timeline draw (タイムラインの描画)
column6: As scrolling progresses, a thin line on the left grows from top to bottom; each node it reaches fills in and its week, title and note slide in from the left. Scrolling back shrinks the line and hides the steps.

column4: Pop-in (ポップイン)
column6: An app icon pops in with a bounce, then a notification badge pops in a moment later.

column4: Stagger (スタガー)
column6: Chart bars rise one after another from the left, each slightly delayed.

column4: Burst (バースト)
column6: A like heart fills in, and a ring, lines and dots burst outward at the same moment.
